canonical.title: Find the Nth Fibonacci Number
canonical.sourceFilePath: 14. Dynamic Programming/1. Intro to DP/01. Find the nth fibonacci number.cpp

narrative.title: The Beacon Pulse Ledger
narrative.scenario: A deep-space relay logs how many beacons are airborne each hour, and the count always follows a Fibonacci-style drift: each hour's total is the sum of the two previous hours' totals. Mission control wants to forecast the count for any hour N without replaying the whole log. Your job is to compute the Nth value in this pulse series, where hour 0 counts 0 beacons and hour 1 counts 1.
narrative.inputFormat: A single integer n, the hour index to forecast.
narrative.outputFormat: Return the nth number of the sequence defined by f(0) = 0, f(1) = 1, f(n) = f(n-1) + f(n-2).

testCases.explanation: The series runs 0, 1, 1, 2, 3, 5 — the fifth value is 5.

hintLevels: Level 1: Each answer is just the sum of the two before it — the recurrence is handed to you.
Level 2: Walk n from 0 upward, keeping the last two values instead of a full table.
Level 3: n = 0 returns 0 and n = 1 returns 1; the loop can start at 2 with those two seeds.
